interpretation: The logged-in UI visibly accepted and persisted the temporary memory-alert configuration after a full page reload. However, an idle baseline with memory usage around 10.6%, threshold 1%, and duration 1 minute still produced no active alert or history record after about 90 seconds. The frontend bundle shows configuration is written through POST/DELETE /api/beszel/user-alerts, while the alerts collection is the runtime alert-state stream. This narrows the unresolved issue to Beszel's alert evaluation/history delivery path in this deployment, without proving the exact internal cause. The GET form of /api/beszel/user-alerts is not exposed (404). No further notification or mutation was attempted.
